1c:T704,{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"Do freelancers need an ITIN?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Non-US citizen freelancers who earn income from US clients or platforms like Upwork and Fiverr need an ITIN to report that income to the IRS and file a US tax return. The ITIN serves as your taxpayer identification number."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I work on Upwork without an ITIN?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Upwork allows you to create an account without an ITIN, but they will eventually require tax information. Without an ITIN or SSN, Upwork may withhold 30% of your earnings for tax purposes.
